ERR_DISPLAY_BAD_WINDOW.message: {id}: the area {x1},{y1} to {x2},{y2} is empty, outside the screen or does not match the picture sent

ERR_DISPLAY_FLUSH_BUSY.message: {id} is still drawing the previous picture

ERR_DISPLAY_TRANSFER.message: {id}: the picture could not be sent ({code})

ERR_DISPLAY_FLUSH_TIMEOUT.message: {id} did not finish drawing within {timeout_ms}: it is restarted
ERR_DISPLAY_FLUSH_TIMEOUT.hint: Check the display's wiring and power.

ERR_DISPLAY_LOST.hint: Check the display's cable and power; it is restarted when it answers again.
